name: Image DPI Changer (72 to 300 DPI)

seo.title: Image DPI Changer (72 to 300 DPI) — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Change PNG or JPEG resolution metadata without resampling pixels, so physical print dimensions change while pixel dimensions remain constant.

assumptions: DPI is metadata only in this tool; it does not create additional image detail.
limitations: Some software ignores or rewrites density metadata, and browser canvas export normally defaults to 96 DPI.
